system.name: daVinci-Dev (agent-native mid-training recipe)
system.one_liner: Agentic mid-training recipe for software engineering: contextually-native and environment-native trajectories built from GitHub PRs turn Qwen2.5 into daVinci-Dev.

content.variant_note: a recipe diagram where one PR source fans out into two data types that merge into mid-training, plus a headline result bar chart at the right
content.argues: Two complementary agent-native data types built from PR elements give a mid-trained model that beats the previous open recipe KIMI-DEV on SWE-Bench Verified.
content.subject: GitHub PR elements turned into two trajectory types, mid-training Qwen2.5 into daVinci-Dev, and a bar chart of 48.6 against 58.5.

lessons.what_to_learn: When data come from one source in two ways, fan the source out into two colour-coded ingredient cards, give each a titled trajectory table and a one-line benefit caption, merge both into the model card, and end with a headline bar chart carrying a bold gain label.
lessons.suits: Data-recipe or training-recipe papers with one source split into complementary data types and one headline comparison.

evidence: Left: We curate two complementary datasets using different elements of PRs.
Comparison of our best performance and the best performance of the previous open software engineering mid-training recipe KIMI-DEV
construct two complementary data types, as illustrated in Figure 1

summary: daVinci-Dev is an agentic mid-training recipe for software-engineering agents. Figure 1 has two parts. At left, a grey Github PR pill fans out through a purple arrow to base files, issues, commits and comments, and through a blue arrow to a problem description, unit tests, a Docker environment and an agentic model. These feed two trajectory tables on a cream panel: contextually native (Issue, Relevant files, Patches, tagged Localize and Edits, benefit Coverage and Diversity) and environment native (Localize, Edit, Test, Revise in a real execution environment, benefit Interaction Authenticity). Both flow into the Qwen2.5 mid-training and the daVinci-Dev card. At right a red bar chart shows 58.5 against Kimi-Dev's 48.6 on SWE-Bench Verified, a gain of 9.9.
summary_zh: daVinci-Dev 是软件工程智能体的中期训练配方。图一左侧把 GitHub PR 要素分成两路轨迹，汇入 Qwen2.5 中期训练；右侧柱状图显示 SWE-Bench Verified 达 58.5，比 Kimi-Dev 高 9.9。
notes: Prior stage-pipeline kept; contribution-mosaic added because a headline result chart sits beside the recipe (it comes from a separate source file, so the figure is two sub-figures). The first table spells Relevant as Relavant. The role of Agentic Model in the blue card is read from its label only.
